description: An oscillator whose wave is a saturated ramp turned upside down, aggressive and best at low and middle frequencies

params.text: Sets the frequency, three octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz

inputs.text: Adds to the frequency knob at 1V per octave, with the total held between four octaves below C4 and six above

notes: the step at the end of each cycle is smoothed with a minBLEP so that it does not alias, and a 1Hz filter takes the DC offset off the result.
the module runs at four times the sample rate below a 50kHz engine rate, twice above that and once above 100kHz, so raising Rack's sample rate lightens its load.
the lamp flashes at a hundredth of the oscillator's frequency and goes dark while the output is unpatched.
